The draft records v3 only, keeps frozen v1 and v2 explicitly labelled as not-this-subject, names the single Stage A advisory CODEX-G32-V3-ADV-1 and correctly reports zero Claude advisories, carries the complete contiguous D-167 through D-208 non-unwrite span including D-168, leaves required-now at 28 and DR-G32 at OPEN, and affirms rather than denies that D-056 gates 2 and 3 hold.
